Commentary.Commentary: Great recovery from the hosts. After a very good start by Bangladesh they have just not put the right finishing touches. They dominated in the Powerplay picking up 4 wickets for just 35 runs. The Pereras then made sure Sri Lanka get past the 150-mark. Thisara and Kusal both got to their fifties to give their bowlers something to bowl at. Mehidy Hasan bowled well to give just 16 of his 4 overs and take a wicket. Strangely, Shakib bowled just the two overs and Nazmul Islam didn't even get the ball. Not the biggest of targets. If the visitors get off to a good start they can easily pull this off. Let's see how they go about it. Second innings in a while.
Good comeback from Rubel after going for a boundary in the first over. Gets the yorker right, Udana plays it towards mid off and manages just a single. SRI LANKA END WITH 159/7 in their 20 overs.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads. One run added to the total.
Right on the money, Udana hits it through covers for a single.
Pitched up, Udana lofts it over mid on for a brace.

OUT! Perera falls in the last over trying to up the ante. Slow ball around off, Thisara is early in his shot and the ball skies towards mid off. Tamim moves to his left from extra cover and takes a juggling catch. A well played innings comes to an end.
FOUR! Goes for the yorker and gives a low full toss for Thisara who hits it over covers for a boundary. Great start to the over.
Another loft over mid on. Thisara will keep strike for the final over.
Wide. This one is down the leg side and the batsman leaves it alone. The umpire has signalled a wide.
In the air...but safe. Udana lofts this over mid on and comes back for the third as Mahmudullah slides near the rope to parry it towards his teammate who didn't read the game well.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

SIX! Pitched up and Thisara lofts it over long on for a biggie. Sabbir Rahman the fielder there was ahead of the boundary line. He jumps for it but the ball is well over him. Had he been a bit behind, might have been a different story.
Isuru Udana is the new man in.

OUT! Finally a wicket for Bangladesh! The partnership is broken but has the damage been done? A change of bowling has done the trick. Slow ball outside off, Kusal reaches for it outside his off stump and hits it towards square leg. The ball takes an edge of the bat and skies towards deep square leg. Mehidy Hasan gets under it and takes a good catch.
On the pads of Thisara, who misses his flick and they steal a leg bye as the ball goes towards square leg.
Soumya Sarkar comes for his second over.
Thisara drives this through covers for one.
Driven to the covers by the batsman for a rare dot.
Full this time, Thisara drives this in the gap through covers and a poor throw from the deep enables them to come back for the second.
Drags his length back, Thisara pulls this towards square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Pitched up ball, Thisara hits it hard towards long on for a boundary.
Kusal guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Rubel Hossain comes back into the attack.
Dot ball to end the over, but a very good one for the hosts. Slow ball outside off, Thisara misses his big shot.
Bangs this short again, Thisara pulls this in front of square on the leg side for another two runs.
SIX! Beautiful shot from Perera! Slow ball in line of the stumps, Thisara chips it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
SIX! Short ball, Thisara well in control of the pull and hits it over deep square leg for the second maximum.
Short ball, Thisara pulls this to square leg for a brace.
Back of a length ball, Kusal tucks it through mid-wicket for one.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl his last over.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Back of a length ball, Thisara punches this towards mid on for a run.
Another couple of runs through mid-wicket. Thisara taps it there and charges back for two.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Great improvisation! Serves this on leg, Kusal reveres sweeps this through backward point for a boundary.
Kusal works this through mid-wicket and comes back for the second.
Driven towards the mid off region. They pick up a single.
Short ball, Thisara pushes this through mid on for one.
Back of a length ball, Thisara punches this off his back foot on the off for a couple.
Knuckle ball from Sarkar, outside off. Perera goes for a big heave but gets beaten.
Fifty for Kusal! Taps this towards mid-wicket and picks up a run. His 10th T20I fifty. He continues his rich vein of form.
FOUR! Interesting change of bowlers. Slow ball outside off, Kusal cuts it past point for a boundary. This brings up the fifty stand for the home team.
Soumya Sarkar comes in for his first over.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short ball, Kusal gets a bottom edge to this and the ball goes to the bowler.
How did that miss the stump? Flat ball on his off pole, Kusal goes for the sweep and the ball just misses his off stump.
In the gap this time. Kusal plays this with soft hands through mid-wicket and comes back for the second.
Kusal hits this back to the bowler.
Flighted ball, Thisara works it through mid-wicket for one.
Rahman bowls this short again. Perera flat bats this over mid off over a run.
FOUR! Easy pickings for Thisara. Rahman digs this one short too. Perera makes room and hits it in the vacant deep backward point region for a boundary.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Follows the six with a boundary. Short again and this time outside off. Kusal flashes hard at it and the ball flies over backward point to the fence. 1000 T20I runs for the southpaw. He is playing a very important knock here. Taking his team out of troubled waters with this innings and partnership with Thisara. Also, he is now the quickest to this mark for Sri Lanka, taking 34 innings.
SIX! Bangs this short and Kusal pulls it high and handsome over mid-wicket for the first maximum.
Back of a length ball, Kusal plays it through mid-wicket and quickly comes back for the second.
The Fizz is back on to bowl. His figures for now are two overs, two wickets and just four runs.
Stays on the back foot and punches it down the ground for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fires this one in, on middle, Thisara helps it to mid-wicket and crosses.

NOT OUT! Kusal has dived his way home. A shortish ball on middle, Thisara goes on the back foot and works it through mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep has to run across to collect the ball and seeing that the batsmen attempt for the second run. The fielder comes up with a direct hit at the bowler's end as Kusal dives in. They appeal and the umpire takes it upstairs. The replays roll in and it shows that the dive has saved KP! Sri Lanka can take a huge sigh of relief.
Run out appeal! Direct hits are always interesting. Seems touch and go at the non-striker's end. The umpire has referred it upstairs...
Flighted full ball on off, defended off the front foot.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Smart batting, gets a full ball around middle and tickles it to mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Wow, even better. The bowler overpitches this time, over-correcting his length and it's on middle. Perera brings down a straight bat and creams it down the ground for a glorious boundary. Surely this is a better pitch than the scoreline suggests.

FOUR! Excellent shot, by far the best of the match, so far. Rubel goes short and Kusal swivels on the back foot with the pull shot. Makes superb connection and sends it screaming to the deep backward square leg fence.
Better this time. Calmly works a length ball to mid-wicket and takes a run.
Another play and a miss outside off for Thisara. He needs to watch the ball before swinging his bat.
Beaten! Full and outside off, Perera swishes and misses.
Rubel Hossain is into the attack.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On the pads of Perera who works it towards fine leg for a brace.
Another single through mid-wicket as Perera jogs to the other end.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.

NOT OUT! A WASTE of a review. Shakib gets too excited as wickets fall on the other end. Tossed up ball around off, Perera taps it through covers and moves to the other end. The bowler thinks that has hit him on the pad and consults his skipper. They decide to take it up. Replays show that the ball was nowhere close to the pad and has only come of the meat.
An appeal for LBW is taken up.
FOUR! Stop the press. A boundary for Sri Lanka. outside off, Perera cuts this through backward point for a much needed boundary.
Good end of the over. Perera covers his timber and defends it. Two runs and a wicket from it.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
Perera plays this with soft hands and the ball goes to the fielder at point.
Around off, Perera pushes this through covers for one more.
Tossed up, Perera eases it to mid-wicket for a run.
Thisara Perera is next to bat.

OUT! Sri Lanka are losing wickets faster than they change their captains. Hasan gives this air around off. Mendis reaches for it and goes for the sweep. He sweeps this from the off and his bottom hand comes off the handle. The ball flies to short fine leg and Mustafizur Rahman gets under it and takes an easy catch. Mendis has to take the long walk back.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Mendis punches this ball to the off.
That kept low. Mendis goes for the big sweep and the ball goes under his bat in the keeper's glove.
Quicker again, Mendis gets behind the ball and blocks it.
Wide. The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire signals a wide.
Darts this around leg, Perera taps it around the corner and gives his partner the strike.
Around off, Mendis gets an edge towards backward point for one.
Mahmudullah is into the attack.
A touch flatter this time, length remains full, Jeevan opens the face of the bat and places his shot through point for a run.
Strides forward to a loopy full ball again and pushes it with gentle hands to covers. Not in the gap.
Slower through the air this time, tossed up and landing full on middle, Jeevan lunges and defends it back.
Flatter and shorter, on middle, Kusal gets deep inside the crease and strokes it through covers for one.
A late cut on this occasion but he finds the fielder at backward point.
Shortish around off, holding up a bit, Perera gets back and mistimes his punch to covers.
Slight halt in play. Seems something has gone in Perera's eyes. He is washing his face. Wearing a helmet can help him a bit too, not completely though in this case.

Straying down the pads of Mendis, he misses his flick and the ball hits his pad and runs past the keeper. They pick up two runs for it. End of the Powerplay, Bangladesh clearly dominating the play. Sri Lanka are 35-4 and have lost their cream.
Wide. Unusual bounce. Too high to worry the batsman! Wide signalled by the umpire.
Length again, Mendis blocks this from the crease.
Jeevan Mendis joins Perera in the middle.

OUT! In comes Shanaka and out he goes. Two wickets in an over for Bangladesh. Rahman serves this on a good length in the line of the stumps, the ball angles after pitching and moves away from Shanaka. He is tentative in his shot and gets a faint edge on it. The ball settles in the gloves of Rahman. And the Men in Green are all smiles. Shanaka won't even need a shower after this.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Dasun Shanaka walks in next.

OUT! Big mix-up and Tharanga is well short of his mark. This is a big blow for the hosts and a rather soft one. Back of a length ball, Tharanga tucks it away to mid-wicket. Perera doesn't look where the ball is and takes off. Mehidy Hasan the fielder there, picks it up and runs with the ball towards the non-striker's end. Tharanga responds to his partner's call and goes for the run. Hasan gives the ball to the bowler and he completes the formalities. Tharanga is not even in the picture and the umpire raises his finger without even going upstairs.
Serves this on leg stump, Perera taps it to square leg and runs towards the other end.
Wide. The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! Flat outside off, Tharanga rocks back and cuts it perfectly in the gap between backward point and point for a boundary.
On middle stump, Tharanga hits it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball and pitched it on middle. The ball holds a bit and moves away from Tharanga who gets beaten by the spin. The keeper takes the bails off but Upul is safely inside.
Darts this on middle stump. Perera makes room and drives it through covers for one more.
Quicker again on the pads of Tharanga, who flicks it off his pads to square leg to rotate strike.
Fires this outside off, Perera cuts it to backward point and goes to the other end.
Upul Tharanga is the new batsman. Change in bowling as well, Mehidy Hasan to bowl his off spinners.

OUT! The batsman in form has departed! This is a big blow to Sri Lanka. Rahman with the breakthrough. Once again he holds his pace back and length too, Mendis opts to pull but fails to get proper timing on it. Ends up chipping it towards Sarkar at mid-wicket who leaps a bit and catches the ball safely over his head. Kusal Mendis failed to get going today, played a few mistimed shots earlier also but was lucky not to get out then. Bangladesh are ecstatic, what a start for them in the Powerplay!
A quick off cutter, says Manjrekar on air, gets good grip and it curves away a bit after landing around off, Mendis pushes inside the line and misses.
Back of a length ball around off, Mendis is on the back foot and chops it down to point.
Keeps bowling on a length outside off, Mendis this time remains on the back foot and taps it down to point.
Play and a miss! Once again Rahman serves it on a length and offers width outside off, Mendis throws his bat at it but fails to connect.
Angling down the leg side, on a good length, Perera fails to flick and it goes off his thigh pad to short fine leg. They steal a leg bye.
Mustafizur Rahman comes into the attack now.
Fuller this time, Mendis plays it for the mid-wicket fielder to collect.
Flatter ball on the off, Mendis cuts it to the fielder at point.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Very good looking shot. Short again, around off, Perera gives room and cracks it through the cover-point region for a boundary.
Short ball outside off, Mendis goes back and punches it on the off side for a single.
Kusal Perera is the new batsman in.

OUT! There goes the first wicket! And the man back from injury strikes. He gets a wicket in his second over itself. Slower ball, in the line of the stumps, Gunathilaka goes for the big slog sweep but doesn't connect well enough. The ball hits the bottom half of the bat and skies straight up in the air. Sabbir Rahman runs from the boundary line (at long on) to his right and gets under it to take a very good catch near long off. He made it look easy but these are very difficult to take under the lights. The Bangladeshis are delighted as they join him in celebration.
FOUR! A boundary to end the over. Overpitched ball on middle and leg. Mendis works it through mid-wicket in the gap. The fielder from mid on hares behind it but only comes second best.
FOUR! Short ball and Mendis goes for a flat-batted shot. He doesn't time it well though. The fielder at mid off looked interested for a moment but it goes over him for the first boundary.
Length in line of the stumps, Mendis stays back and blocks it.
Around off, Gunathilaka works it around the corner and picks up a run.

NOT OUT! Length outside off, Gunathilaka cuts it behind backward point and picks up a couple of runs. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end as Mendis was jogging back. The bowler takes the bails out. The umpire doesn't take a chance and goes upstairs. Replays show that Mendis was well in.
An appeal for a run out has been referred upstairs. Bangladesh don't look excited. Let's see.
Comes steaming in and plays it towards mid-wicket for one.
Rubel Hossain will bowl from the other end.
Outside off, Mendis drives this through covers and quickly moves to the other end for a quick single. The fielder there has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses his aim.
Darts this quicker in line of the stumps, Mendis is happy to play it back to the bowler.
Wide. Tosses this down the leg and Mendis goes for the flick but misses. Wide signallad by the umpire.
First run on the board. Bowls this a bit short, Gunathilaka rocks back and punches this through mid off for a run.
Good start for Shakib. Three dots in a row. Flatter ball, around off, Gunathilaka cuts it to the fielder at point.
Fuller this time, Gunathilaka leans forward and drives this to mid off for nothing.
Starts off with a loopy ball around off, Gunathilaka gets behind the ball and defends it.

The Sri Lankan pair of Danushka Gunathilaka and Kusal Mendis have made their way in the middle. The fielders have taken their positions. Shakib Al Hasan will bowl with the new ball. A slip in place. Here we go...
The players have made their way out for their respective national anthems. We are not far away from the start of play.

Sri Lanka have made two changes to their side -  Amila Aponso and Isuru Udana come in for Suranga Lakmal and Dushmantha Chameera. The visitors, on the other side, have made just one change. Abu Hider makes way for skipper Shakib Al Hasan.

Thisara Perera, the Sri Lankan skipper says that he is happy to bat first as he feels that the pitch is a bit slow. States that they want to put on a big score and then defend it.  Further adds that they have taken positives from the previous games and are up for this crunch game.

Shakib Al Hasan says it is a good wicket and reckons that it will remain the same for 40 overs. Continues saying that they would like to restrict the Lankans and then chase down the total. On his injury, he replies that he is fit but just lacks match practice.
TOSS - Shakib Al Hasan calls tails, and tails it is! Bangladesh will bowl first!

PITCH REPORT - Brett Lee is in the middle for the pitch report. He says that it is a beautiful wicket and looks like a belter. He adds by saying that there is a good cover of grass but very few cracks. He feels that it is a good pitch for batting and the ball will come nicely to the bat. Ends by saying that 180-190 should be a good score.

Hello and welcome to a virtual semi-final clash between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. Remember the first match between these two teams in this series? Yes, Mushfiqur Rahim's blitz and cobra dance flash in our minds. The visitors will be confident coming into this game even though they lost their last game against India. Also, with the return of Shakib Al Hasan, there will be a different vibe in the dressing room. The hosts, on the flip side, after an 'upset' win over India never managed to cross the finish line post that. An important game for both as the winner meets India in the final. Promises to be a cracker.
